target_control.distribution: 512 unchanged target-control rows selected by floor((2*i+1)*N/(2*512))
target_control.finite_support_mean: stored separately; no centering/rescaling to force equality

source_mean.response: equal arithmetic mean of three source perturbed absolute-expression means
source_mean.historical_mixture: Not exported. The later requested mean-only Source-Mean definition excludes empirical source mixtures.

statistics: One estimate per fold; five-fold mean, sample variance and sample SD, ddof=1; no training seed variance
prediction_inputs: Target-Control: target controls only. Source-Mean: same-target perturbations from three legal training contexts only.
